newsitem.title: CHINA: Mild earthquake rocks China's capital.
newsitem.headline: Mild earthquake rocks China's capital.

text.p: A mild earthquake measuring 4.0 on the open-ended Richter scale shook the Chinese capital early on Monday, the State Earthquake Bureau said.
The earthquake, centred in the northern Beijing suburb of Shunyi, struck at 5.36 a.m. (2136 GMT).
Residents reported light fixtures swaying and bath water spilling from tubs but seismological officials said there were no reports of injuries or property damage.
